title: Iloilo City marks 89th Charter Day, celebrates growth and heritage

blocks.text: Declared a special non-working holiday last August 25, the milestone commemorated the city’s formal inauguration as a chartered municipality in 1937 — a pivotal moment born from the historic merger of the old towns of Iloilo, La Paz, Arevalo, and the port district of Jaro.
